name: UI：任务管理-详情页图片预览验证
description: 验证详情页表格中展示主图/子图/参考图

steps.expression: (() => { const imgs = document.querySelectorAll('.ant-table-row img'); const mainImgs = Array.from(imgs).filter(img => img.alt === 'main' || img.src.includes('llm')); const subImgs = Array.from(imgs).filter(img => img.alt === 'sub' || img.src.includes('design')); const refText = document.body.innerText.includes('参考图'); return { totalImgs: imgs.length, mainImgCount: mainImgs.length, subImgCount: subImgs.length, hasRefText: refText }; })()

_testDesign.preconditions: F88预发已登录；存在任务管理数据
_testDesign.realDomNotes: 每行展示主图+子图，参考图以'参考图+N'文字显示
